name: prometheus-web-obfuscator
description: Interface Web para Prometheus Lua Obfuscator

scripts.build: mkdir -p bin && curl -R -O https://www.lua.org/ftp/lua-5.1.5.tar.gz && tar zxf lua-5.1.5.tar.gz && cd lua-5.1.5 && make linux && cp src/lua ../bin/lua && cd .. && rm -rf lua-5.1.5 lua-5.1.5.tar.gz && curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/prometheus-lua/Prometheus/master/install.sh | sh && cp -L ~/.local/bin/prometheus-lua ./bin/prometheus-cli && chmod +x ./bin/*
